acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Treants family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Sapling-walker, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Whip-Root Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Thin whip-like trunk, few leaves, shallow root feet, and a face barely suggested in bark.
Signature mechanic: Shallow Plant: one root foot spreads and the opposite whip-like branch sweeps its narrow arc.
battlefieldDuty: Probe close footwork with one shallow-root lash.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no heartwood cavity, no waterfall, no boulders, and no groves; T4 alone gains the source-supported heartwood cavity; T5 alone carries its waterfall, boulders, and groves.
Char-controlled bark plates, resin fuel channels, ember-pruned branch tips, directional smoke vents, and blackened firebreak seams add combustion while preserving living growth.
counterplay: Cross behind the planted root and strike the thin trunk before it pulls free. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no heartwood cavity, no waterfall, no boulders, and no groves, so a resin channel exposes a root seam; T4 heartwood cavity opens after venting; T5 waterfall, boulders, and groves reveal one firebreak root when the canopy burns.
identityInvariants: Vertical trunk body, root-cluster legs, long branch arms, a bark-suggested face, and canopy remain recognizable.
Bark brown and grey, moss green, autumn gold, sap, and restrained amber heartwood remain botanical materials.
Nests, vines, mushrooms, bark runes, scars, and growth rings record age without replacing readable joints.
Girth, canopy, rooted reach, and resident ecosystems escalate while branch load and root commitment preserve counterplay.
telegraph: Few leaves turn edge-on while one shallow root fans across the ground.
